name: Anxious But Sincere
description: The student wants to improve but often sounds worried, uncertain, or afraid of failure.
support_strategy: Use calm reassurance, reduce overload, give one clear next step, and celebrate small progress.

name: Motivated But Inconsistent
description: The student shows interest and intent, but consistency breaks because of missed sessions or drift.
support_strategy: Use short plans, accountability check-ins, recovery scheduling, and momentum-building tasks.

name: Burned Out Learner
description: The student seems drained, mentally tired, and at risk of disengaging if pressure stays high.
support_strategy: Lower load temporarily, simplify explanations, focus on recovery and emotional safety before ramping back up.

name: Confused But Engaged
description: The student participates and asks questions, but often signals confusion or misunderstanding.
support_strategy: Break concepts into smaller chunks, avoid jargon, ask one question at a time, and use examples.

name: Avoiding Difficult Sections
description: The student tends to skip or postpone weak areas, often redirecting away from hard topics.
support_strategy: Reduce avoidance by starting with easy wins inside weak sections and gradually increasing challenge.

name: High Effort Low Accuracy
description: The student is putting in work, but outcomes remain weak and they may need diagnostic support.
support_strategy: Focus on misconceptions, exam strategy, and guided practice rather than just adding more volume.

name: Needs Reassurance
description: The student benefits strongly from warm encouragement and can lose momentum without emotional support.
support_strategy: Use supportive tone, normalize struggle, and frame progress as steady improvement instead of judgment.

name: Responds To Challenge
description: The student appears energized by structure and challenge and can handle more direct coaching.
support_strategy: Use stretch goals, direct performance feedback, and higher challenge while keeping it constructive.
